basis: PLATEAU original rectangular shell and recessed/parapet roof retained. October18 view.tokyo article shows a white equipment-like facility near old platform; association with bldg_5369333e and exact identity remain inferred, not independently confirmed. No generic residential windows; metal panel/louver types used as B estimates. Joint spacing, vent position and dimensions not surveyed. Local C2a skirt added without shifting roof.
joint_revision_basis: Initial model inspection showed a pronounced grid on an equipment-like facade. October18 reference shows a largely plain white shell with subdued panel seams. Reduced seam width only from .07m to .025m as a B estimate; positions, material colour, vent, roof and shell unchanged. No calibrated pixel measurement.
